label: PF Backlog 576
title: Eventing SSOT: ADR + design (Go-first bus, Python thin client, no-duplication, migration)
body:
## Problem / why
The Go-first + Python-thin-client decision, the no-duplication rule, single-writer ownership of the event
store, and the five open forks (Go packaging, daemon vs library, who serves SSE, store-writer ownership,
Python-emit handoff) are not yet recorded; coding cannot start unrecorded (AGENTS.md reconciliation).

## Goal / value
An accepted ADR + design doc with RECONCILIATION + IMPACT REVIEW so the capability is governed before build.

## In scope
- ADR (docs/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS.md) recording Go-core + Python-thin-client, no second bus/store.
- Design doc with the consumer migration matrix + no-regression DoD + the five open decisions.

## Out of scope
- Any implementation.

## Acceptance criteria
- ADR accepted; design doc lists frozen contracts, migration matrix, and resolved open decisions.
- language/ownership conflicts recorded (events.jsonl owner; event_bus facade).

## Verification / test plan
- `python scripts/dev/design_review_check.py docs/<design>.md` clean; ADR index updated.
